content.title: Chapter 18 - BUILDINGS AND BUILDING REGULATIONS — Sec. 18-505. - I.P.M.C. Section 304.13, Window, skylight and door frames.
content.summary:
Section 304.13. Window, skylight and door frames,
is hereby amended to read as follows:
"
304.13. Window, skylight and door frames.
Every window, skylight and door frame shall be kept in structurally sound condition
                  and weather tight."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 12, 9-14-2020)
